policy.text: PX-GLASS. Glass breakage is in force when photos are on the file. Accept for intake. Do not promise a payout.
PX-FLOOD. Flood is excluded. Return Refuse and quote this rule.
PX-COLLISION. Collision needs photos. If photos are missing, return Need photos.
PX-NO-PAY. Never write “we will pay” or name a settlement amount.

reports.quote: PX-GLASS. Glass breakage is in force when photos are on the file. Accept for intake. Do not promise a payout.
